QuestInfo.0: Go tell #b#p2152003##k about the sign situation, as #p2152018# ordered.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152003# said she was scared of the #rsigns#k. Looks like you'll have to get your hands dirty, but her sudden unwillingness is a little strange... \n\n#o1150001##r #a254101##k

0.0: Look, I'm sorry to ask, but I really don't like those signs. They give me the heeby-jeebies! Please, as long as SOMEONE takes care of it, #p2152018# won't say anything.

yes.0: That's what I wanted to hear. Just report back to #b#p2152018##k when #r50#k of the  #r#o1150001##k monsters are gone!

1.0: You went and did #p2152003#'s work for her? That lady... \r\n#L0##bAre you and #p2152003# close?#l\n#k
1.1: Yeah, you could say that. I've lived here forever and I've seen good people get turned into things they weren't. Watching you help out that brat makes me think you're not too much of a Black Wing yourself.\r\n#L0##bWhat does it mean to be a Black Wing?#l\n#k
1.2: It means being a real fink. It means kidnapping innocent women and tearing peoples' lives apart. Being a Black Wing means being a scumbag.\r\n#L0##bKidnapping women, you say?#l\n#k
1.3: It's none of your business, stranger. I don't know why you joined the Black Wings and I don't care. Just keep an eye on them. They're not good folks.

yes.0: If I could just get her back...
yes.1: #b(Wonny was forced into joining the Black Wings. He won't have any important information. It's time to move on to Watchman Bavan.)#k
